text:
Students are asked to distinguish between analogue and digital signals.
Which statement is correct?
A
Digital signals cannot transmit data at a higher rate than analogue signals.
B
Digital signals travel slower than analogue signals.
C
Digital signals cannot transmit sound data.
D
Digital signals have values of 1 or 0.

options.label: A
options.text: Digital signals cannot transmit data at a higher rate than analogue signals.

options.label: B
options.text: Digital signals travel slower than analogue signals.

options.label: C
options.text: Digital signals cannot transmit sound data.

options.label: D
options.text: Digital signals have values of 1 or 0.
